summary: Article publishing app with an admin approval step required before articles can be published; also needs removal of two already-published articles.

existing_features.title: Enforce an explicit admin-approval workflow: stories submitted by users must remain in a pending state and must not appear in any public listing (feed/articles) until an admin publishes them.
Add admin-only functionality to remove/unpublish published articles so the admin can delete the two already-published articles from the site by title.

new_feature_requests.summary: Require admin approval before an article can be published (add approval workflow/gating).
Remove two already-published articles from the site/app.

When an admin publishes a submitted story, remove it from the pending submissions list so it no longer appears as 'pending' in admin moderation views and does not remain duplicated as both pending and published.

projectName: Require admin approval before publication and let admin remove published articles
